brandPositioningSummary: AC Hotels by Marriott is a design-led lifestyle-select Marriott brand within Marriott International. For owners, the affiliation case is urban and suburban upscale-select fit, design standards, public-space and F&B implications, and Marriott Bonvoy platform value. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Moxy Hotels, Courtyard by Marriott, Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio.

scenarios.title: Design-led urban conversion
scenarios.summary: An urban hotel with strong architecture or renovation potential that wants Marriott lifestyle-select positioning. AC fits when design discipline, public space, and service can support a modern business-lifestyle guest promise. Owners should diligence whether AC Hotels by Marriott is a better fit than Moxy Hotels for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: Suburban lifestyle-select new-build
scenarios.summary: A new-build in an upscale suburban or mixed-use node. Diligence should confirm AC design kit expectations, F&B/public-space scope, and whether the market supports lifestyle-select rates versus Courtyard. Owners should diligence whether AC Hotels by Marriott is a better fit than Moxy Hotels for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.

scenarios.title: CALA design-select reference
scenarios.summary: CALA examples such as AC Hotel Guadalajara help owners evaluate design-led Marriott select affiliation in Latin America. Match the property by name and keep geography labels accurate. Owners should diligence whether AC Hotels by Marriott is a better fit than Moxy Hotels for the specific asset, capital plan, and operator capacity.
